messages:
incident_bot: PAGER: Sev2 alert — inference runtime error-rate + latency spike across hosted + private clusters (kv-cache missstorm). Links: https://incidents.redwood/internal/3543210987 :rotating_light:

sara_oncall: taking pager. seeing large KV cache eviction churn after yesterday's quant rollout to canary. TTLs spiking, hit-rate dropping ~28%. rolling mitigation now.

devon_sre: ack. hitting the rollout guard to divert canary -> fallback model and scale router pods by +3. running rollback to runtime:v1.28.3 for canary.

mike_research: noted perf regression in 4-bit quant variant: token latency up 2.2x for >2k contexts and KV key length mismatch in decoder path. likely cause for cache misses.

sara_oncall: mitigation commands posted to runbook and executed:
```
/k8s patch deployment inference-canary -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runtime","image":"redwood/runtime:v1.28.3"}]}}}}'
```

lin_engineer: added immediate config tweak: reduced default batch_size for low-latency routes from 8 -> 4 and disabled kv-prefetch for quant variants. monitoring.

devon_sre: metrics: error-rate fell from 4.8% -> 0.9% within 12m of rollback + routing change. latency trending back to SLO. will keep autoscale at +2 pods for 30m.

tara_pm: customer impact: two mid-market customers reported 5–12s tail latencies and one reported failed request rate. CSMs notified; no data exfiltration.

ops_bot: created remediation tickets: INF-7312 (kv eviction heuristics), INF-7313 (quant rollout guard), INF-7314 (regression perf tests).

sara_oncall: scheduling post-incident review. proposed Wed 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent). agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, rollout policy changes, follow-up owners.

mike_research: I'll add reproducible perf harness + testcase (long contexts + kv stress) and link to INF-7314.

lin_engineer: action items (brief):
- INF-7312: update kvcache eviction policy + metrics (owner: lin_engineer, due: 2026-03-24)
- INF-7313: add rollout guard check for kvcache hit-rate delta > 15% in 30m (owner: devon_sre, due: 2026-03-18)
- INF-7314: perf/regression tests for 4-bit quant + nightly stress (owner: mike_research, due: 2026-03-21)
- Runbook update: oncall mitigation steps + rollback commands (owner: sara_oncall, due: 2026-03-17)

sara_oncall: posted a shared tracker + postmortem draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/INF-POST/3543210987 (please add notes).

devon_sre: added deployment guard: blocked further quant canaries until INF-7313 is closed. Also adding an automated alert if kvcache hit-rate drops > 12% within 20m.

mike_research: will add unit and integration checks to CI: reject quant builds that change KV key serialization without a migration shim.

tara_pm: will coordinate customer comms follow-up after postmortem and confirm credits/next steps with CSMs.

sara_oncall: current status: mitigation stable, telemetry normal for 45m. leaving oncall watch for 2h then handing to next shift. postmortem scheduled; owners assigned. closing pager thread here, updates to remediation tickets + postmortem doc only. :white_check_mark:
